edges.reason: constructor assigns admin from msg.sender establishing privileged role
deposit derives the credited user from msg.sender
withdraw derives the debited user from msg.sender
claimLoanRewards requires msg.sender to be the loan borrower
adminOnly modifier compares msg.sender to admin before reward withdrawal
adminOnly modifier compares msg.sender to admin before rotating admin
deposit resolves palPool from palTokenToPalPool
withdraw resolves palPool from palTokenToPalPool
supplierDeposits increased with SafeMath add during deposit
supplierDeposits decreased with SafeMath sub during withdraw
claim reads and zeroes accruedRewards
transfer amount for claim comes from accruedRewards
loan borrow ratio snapshot feeds reward computation
isLoanRewardClaimed gates double claiming
autoBorrowRewards flag gates automatic accrual
borrowRatios read when snapshotting loan rewards
rewardTokenAddress determines which token is withdrawn
lock modifier uses locked flag to protect deposit
lock modifier uses locked flag to protect withdraw
lock modifier uses locked flag to protect claim
lock modifier uses locked flag to protect claimLoanRewards
deposit updates the supply index before accrual
deposit accrues supply rewards for the user
withdraw updates the supply index before accrual
withdraw accrues supply rewards for the user
claim calls updateUserRewards before paying out
updateUserRewards updates each pool supply index
updateUserRewards accrues supply rewards per pool
deposit executes safeTransferFrom after state updates
withdraw executes safeTransfer of underlying to user
claim transfers reward tokens to the user
claimLoanRewards transfers reward tokens to the borrower
claimLoanRewards computes amount via _calculateLoanRewards
withdrawRewardToken transfers reward tokens to recipient
updatePoolRewards flushes supply index before changing speed
setInitialPools initializes supplyRewardState entries
addNewPool initializes supplyRewardState for the new pool
closeBorrow computes used fees with borrowIndex arithmetic
killBorrow computes fees and reserve deltas arithmetically
proxy fallback routes msg.data into the delegatecall operation
setLoanBorrowRewards writes loansBorrowRatios
accrueBorrowRewards adds computed rewards to accruedRewards
becomeImplementation calls proxy.acceptImplementation cross-contract
fallback delegatecalls into currentImplementation
token transfer during withdraw hands control to untrusted token before completion
token transferFrom during deposit calls an untrusted token contract
reward token transfer during claim calls an external token contract
delegatecall executes arbitrary implementation code and can reenter proxy

normalization_plan.reason: palToken parameter is only meaningful as the deposit/withdraw input key resolving palPool.
amount parameter directly drives the deposit transfer amount and cannot stand alone.
local user is just msg.sender captured inside deposit/withdraw.
user parameter is consumed by the claim reward payout path.
palPool parameter is the key used to read and update the pool reward state.
local palPool resolved in withdraw is an intermediate alias of the registry lookup.
local token handle exists only to perform the safe transfer.
toClaim is the amount transferred out by the reward claim transfer.
currentBlock aliases block.number inside the supply index update.
ellapsedBlocks is a transient arithmetic intermediate of the supply index update.
recipient parameter is the destination of the admin reward token transfer.
newController parameter is only used to reconfigure the registered pools.
loanAddress parameter identifies which loan rewards are claimed.
local _pools is a memory copy of palPools used for the estimation loop.
input address arrays only serve to initialize the pool registry.
